meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成画面自创的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字素材,想快速做成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn articles, notes, or a topic into an explainer video with invented visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have text material and want a quick explainer video.

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记或话题)变成无人出镜的解说视频,画面按场景现造,用排版、图形、图表等。它会依次产出分镜 STORYBOARD.md、脚本 SCRIPT.md、逐帧 HTML,最后渲染成 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你要把文字做成话题解说、概念拆解或操作教程时进入;要基于网站做推广或导览视频则不适用,意图不明确时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这段文章做成一支无人出镜的解说视频。
say.note: 随后进入分镜与脚本环节。

say.text: 这个主题做一支 3 分钟的概念拆解视频,用极简排版风格。
搭帧之前,先给我看草图。
say.note: 草图是分镜阶段的评审选项。

howto.what_en: Turns text — an article, notes, or a topic — into a faceless explainer video; all visuals are invented per scene (typography, diagrams, data-viz). It plans a storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use it for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, or how-tos. Not for a video built from a website (promo or tour); when unclear, go through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Then the storyboard and script steps run.

say_en.text: Make a 3-minute concept breakdown on this topic, minimal typography.
say_en.note: Length and style go into BRIEF.md.

say_en.text: Show me sketches before building the frames.
